question: Do the requirements of the companion ability apply to my sideboard as well as my starting deck?

expected.shortAnswer: No: the requirements apply only to your starting deck, not your sideboard.
expected.answer: The requirements of the companion ability apply only to your starting deck. They do not apply to your sideboard.
